This loop moves `expr` one step along `expression` at a time, and its only way out is the condition — reaching the end of the chain. The analysis cannot place `expression` on one declaration, so nothing proves the chain it makes ever ends. On such data the chain has no end: the condition never becomes false, nothing in the loop leaves it, and the thread running it spins at full CPU for as long as the process lives. Nothing here counts the steps or remembers the objects already visited.

`pkg` is what a parser answered for text from outside the program, which nothing shows a caller cannot choose, and a parser answers whatever the text holds — an object, a list, a number or `null`. Nothing after the parse in this function checks that it is an object before it is used as one, in one place, named beside this one (the first on each path), so text of `null` — and, depending on the use, a number or a list — ends the request in an error there instead of being refused as malformed, and no handler takes the failure.

specs.description:
`build-mcp-metadata.ts` — Build-mcp-metadata. Called from `serve.ts (top level)` and `stdio.ts (top level)`, and possibly from places the call graph cannot see. `main` is where the program ends. `buildTemplate` builds `dependencies`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside it. Observed: “The walk along `expression` has nothing to stop it going round in a circle.” 2 requirements: 2 violated.

1 finding reachable from current code produced no requirement — on `buildTemplate`: a value is used as present without a check.
